newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria, Romania to increase trade.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria, Romania to increase trade.

text.p: Nigerian and Romanian officials have had talks in Lagos on increasing trade between the two countries, diplomats said on Tuesday.
They said a Romanian mission ended a week-long visit on Monday during which general agreement was reached on a wide range of areas including oil and gas, construction and agricultural machinery.
"It was a very positive mission and this will be followed up early next year by a meeting of our joint economic committee in (Nigeria's capital) Abuja," said Romanian ambassador Gheorghe Dumitru.
"We are in the course of finalising an agreement to strengthen and protect our investments in each other's countries," he added.
The value of trade between the two countries rose to $104 million last year from $32 million in 1990 and weighed heavily in favour of Romania.
It included imports of Romanian wood processing plants, railroad equipment and vehicles in return for Nigerian exports of natural rubber, raw hides and cocoa beans.
The trade mission left on Monday for Ghana.
